semiconductor_relevance: High — Astra Technologies UK LLP specializes in cleanroom systems essential for semiconductor manufacturing and related high-tech facilities.
summary: Astra Technologies UK LLP is a specialized manufacturer of cleanroom systems for semiconductor and high-tech facilities, offering both walkable and non-walkable ceiling systems. Their products include fan filter units (FFUs), filters, ceiling panels, and integrated lighting, all certified to UL/FM safety standards.
capabilities: Walkable and non-walkable cleanroom ceiling systems
